en: Tinted/hand-colored street view of a grand corner hotel with a mansard roof and arched ground-floor windows. The entrance canopy reads "HOTEL EUROPA," with people gathered outside and an early automobile parked at the curb. A tree-lined boulevard and benches are in the foreground; a neighboring building bears the word "VOLKSBAD." Printed captions identify the scene as in Sibiu and also give German and Hungarian city names.
